newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UN - 50,000 Hutus cross into Rwanda, thousands on way.
newsitem.headline: UN - 50,000 Hutus cross into Rwanda, thousands on way.

text.p: The U.N. refugee agency said on Friday that more than 50,000 Rwandan Hutus had crossed into Rwanda from eastern Zaire during the day and more were trudging across the border at a rate of more than 160 a minute.
"We had 50,000 refugees crossing into Rwanda as of mid-afternoon. There are another 300,000 to 400,000 on the move," UNHCR spokesman Fernando del Mundo told Reuters.
The UNHCR spokesman said the arrivals were being processed at the Rwandan border in an "orderly" fashion and that the frontier remained open despite the mass influx.
"They (the Rwandans) are quickly checking them at the border. It's very orderly," he said.
UNHCR estimated that up to 400,000 more refugees including displaced Zaireans were also on the move towards the border, he added.
He said the refugees were arriving at Rwanda's northwestern border crossing with Zaire near Gisenyi town at a rate of 10,000 an hour or more than 160 a minute.
